blocks.text: Public cloud aisi cloud service hai jo internet par di jati hai aur kai organizations (companies ya mahkame) ke darmiyan share hoti hai. Ise ek third-party (bahar ki company) cloud service provider sambhalta hai.

Misal (Example): Amazon Web Services (AWS) mashhoor public cloud provider hai. Har size ke karobar AWS se virtual servers aur storage jaise computing resources le sakte hain, aur physical hardware khud sambhalna nahi parta.

blocks.prompt: Public cloud ka physical hardware kaun sambhalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Third-party cloud service provider, customer nahi.

items: Public cloud: internet par, kai organizations mein share, third-party provider ke paas (AWS).
